rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','hba1c',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','target1',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','result1',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','hba1c1',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','target_com',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','hba1c_com',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','result_com',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','target_com1',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','hba1c_com1',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_dm_control','result_com1',' INT(9) DEFAULT 0 ');


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_dm_control(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  hba1c int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  target1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  hba1c1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

  target_com int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  hba1c_com int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result_com int(9) DEFAULT 0,

  target_com1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  hba1c_com1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result_com1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_dm_control WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dm_control 
(
SELECT @id,b.hospcode,b.areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,b.target,b.result,b.hba1c
,a.target1,a.result1,a.hba1c1
,b.target_com,b.hba1c_com,b.result_com
,a.target_com1,a.hba1c_com1,a.result_com1
FROM
(SELECT
p.check_hosp hospcode,p.check_vhid areacode
,COUNT(DISTINCT d.cid) target
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(d.control_dm IN(1),d.cid,NULL )) result
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(d.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,d.cid,NULL )) hba1c

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(TRIM(d.complication_dm)) >0, d.cid,null)) target_com
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(TRIM(d.complication_dm)) >0 AND d.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,d.cid,NULL )) hba1c_com
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(TRIM(d.complication_dm)) >0 AND d.control_dm IN(1),d.cid,NULL )) result_com

FROM
t_dmht d 
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON d.cid=p.CID
WHERE d.cid IS NOT NULL AND d.type_dx in(2,3) AND p.check_typearea IN(1,3) 
AND p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9)
AND substr(p.check_vhid,1,2) IN(@prov_c)
GROUP BY p.check_hosp,p.check_vhid
) b LEFT JOIN (
	SELECT
		f.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2) ,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
		,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid)) target1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.control_dm IN(1), CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) result1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) hba1c1

		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(TRIM(f.complication_dm)) >0, CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) target_com1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(TRIM(f.complication_dm)) >0 AND f.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d, CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) hba1c_com1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(TRIM(f.complication_dm)) >0 AND f.control_dm IN(1), CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) result_com1

  FROM
	t_chronicfu f INNER JOIN t_dmht d ON f.cid=d.cid
	INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.hospcode=h.hoscode
	WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c)  AND f.cid IS NOT NULL AND  d.type_dx in(2,3) AND d.NATION IN(99) 
	GROUP BY h.hoscode,areacode
) a ON b.hospcode = a.hospcode AND b.areacode=a.areacode
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_dm_control 
(
SELECT 
	@id,f.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2) ,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
		,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
		,NULL,NULL,NULL
		,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid)) target1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.control_dm IN(1), CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) result1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(f.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d ,CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL )) hba1c1
		,NULL,NULL,NULL
  		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(TRIM(f.complication_dm)) >0, CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) target_com1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(TRIM(f.complication_dm)) >0 AND f.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d, CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) hba1c_com1
		,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(LENGTH(TRIM(f.complication_dm)) >0 AND f.control_dm IN(1), CONCAT(f.hospcode,'-',f.pid),NULL)) result_com1
FROM
	t_chronicfu f INNER JOIN t_dmht d ON f.cid=d.cid
	INNER JOIN chospital h ON f.hospcode=h.hoscode
	WHERE h.provcode in(@prov_c)  AND f.cid IS NOT NULL AND  d.type_dx in(2,3) AND d.NATION IN(99) 
	GROUP BY h.hoscode,areacode
);

rows.indiv_sql:
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');
DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx(
SELECT
h.hoscode as hospcode, h.hosname, p.PID, p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX, p.BIRTH
,p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA, d.ld_hba1c, ROUND(d.rs_hba1c,2) AS rs_hba1c
, d.ih_hba1c, if(d.control_dm IN(1) AND d.ld_hba1c BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d,'ควบคุมได้','ควบคุมไม่ได้') AS control,d.complication_dm
FROM
t_dmht d
INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON d.CID = p.CID
INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE d.CID IS NOT NULL AND d.type_dx in(2,3) AND p.check_typearea IN(1,3) 
AND p.NATION IN(99) AND p.DISCHARGE IN(9) 
);
SELECT
h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX
, d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA
, d.ld_hba1c, d.rs_hba1c, d.ih_hba1c,d.control,d.complication_dm
FROM
tx d
INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, sum("target") as "target" ,sum("result") as "result" ,sum("hba1c") as "hba1c" ,sum("target1") as "target1" ,sum("result1") as "result1" ,sum("hba1c1") as "hba1c1" ,sum("target_com") as "target_com" ,sum("result_com") as "result_com" ,sum("hba1c_com") as "hba1c_com" ,sum("target_com1") as "target_com1" ,sum("result_com1") as "result_com1" ,sum("hba1c_com1") as "hba1c_com1" ,sum("target"-"target_com") as "target_ncom" ,sum("result"-"result_com") as "result_ncom" ,sum("hba1c"-"hba1c_com") as "hba1c_ncom" ,sum("target1"-"target_com1") as "target_ncom1" ,sum("result1"-"result_com1") as "result_ncom1" ,sum("hba1c1"-"hba1c_com1") as "hba1c_ncom1"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
